spans.s:
m. (-भः)
1 The month Śrāvaṇa.
2 Æther, atmosphere.
f. (-भा)
1 A spitting pot.
2 The city of the sun.
E.
नह to bind, affix भ; see नभस्.

m. (-न्ति)
A lion.
E.
नभस् a cloud, and क्रान्तिन् who goes; whose shape is seen in the clouds.

m. (-णः)
Air, wind.
E.
नभस् atmosphere, and प्राण life or breath.

m. (-सद्)
A deity.
E.
नभस् heaven, and सद् who travels, from सद to go, with क्विप् aff.

f. (-रित्)
The celestial Ganges.
E.
नभस् heaven, and सरित् a river.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Celestial, aerial, heavenly, etherial.
E.
नभस्, and स्थ what stays; also नभस्स्थ.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
A biding in heaven or in the sky.
m. (-तः)
A division of the infernal regions, a hell.
E.
नभस् atmosphere, and स्थित a staying; also नभस्स्थित.

m. (-क्षुः)
The sun.
E.
नभस् heaven, and चक्षुस् the eye.

m. (-सः)
1 The moon.
2 A variegated cake.
3 Conjuring.
E.
नभस् heaven, and चमस a sort of ladle, &c.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Going in the air or heaven.
m. (-रः)
1 A bird.
2 A Vidyādhara or demigod so called.
3 A cloud.
4 Air, wind.
E.
नभस् heaven, and चर who goes.

m. (-भाः)
1 The month Śrāvaṇa, (July-August.)
2 A cloud.
3 The rains, or rainy season.
4

Smell.
5

The fibres in the root of the lotus.
6 A bird.
7 A grey-headed man.
n. (-भः)
Sky, atmosphere, æther or heaven.
E.
नभ to injure, to be annihilated, (at the end of the world,) Uṇādi affix असुन्, or नह to bind, and भ substituted for ह.

n. (-सं)
Heaven, sky, &c. see the last.
E.
नभ as above, Uṇādi affix असच्.

m. (-मः)
A bird.
E.
नभस heaven, गम to go, affix खच.

m. (-लः)
The atmosphere.
E.
नभस् sky, and तल below.

m. (-स्यः)
The month Bhādra, (August-September.)
E.
नभस् a cloud or rain, and यत् aff.

m. (-स्वान्)
Air, wind.
E.
नभस्, and मतुप् aff.

n. (-कं)
Darkness.
E.
नभ to injure, आक Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.)

m. (-भिः)
A wheel.

f. (-भिः-भी)
1 The nave of a wheel.
2 Musk.
mf. (-भिः and भिः or भी)
The navel.
m. (-भिः)
1 An emperor, a sovereign, a lord paramount.
2 A king, a chief.
3 A Kṣatriya or Hindū of the regal and military tribe.
4 The son of

PRIYAVRATA.
5

A race, a family.
E.
नह to bind, Uṇādi affix इञि, and भ substituted for ह.

m. (-जः)
A cloud.
E.
नभस् sky, and गज an elephant.

f. (-तिः)
Flying, soaring, going in the air.
E.
नभस् sky and गति going.

m. (-हः)
A cloud.
E.
नभस् rain, (-दुह) to milk, affix क.

m. (-पः)
A cloud.
E.
नभस् rain, द्वीप an island.

m. (-मः)
A cloud.
E.
नभस् sky, and भूम smoke.

f. (-दी)
The celestial Ganges.
E.
नभस् heaven, and नदी a river.

m. (-णिः)
The sun.
E.
नभस् sky, मणि a gem.

नभोऽम्बुप
m. (-पः)
The Cātaka, (Cuculus melanoleucos.)
E.
नभस् sky, अम्बु water, and प who drinks.

n. (-जः)
Darkness.
E.
नभस् sky, and रजस् dust.

f. (-णुः)
Fog, mist, vapour.
E.
नभस् sky, and रेणु thin dust.

m. (-यः)
Smoke.
E.
नभस् sky, and लय abode.

mfn. (-लिट्)
Lofty, towering, rising to the clouds.
E.
नभस्, and लिह् what touches.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
Relating to the nave of a wheel, resembling it, &c.
E.
नभ for नाभि, and यत् aff.

mfn. (-भ्यः-भ्या-भ्यं)
Umbilical, of or relating to the navel.
E.
नाभि the navel, and यत aff.

m. (-भ्राट्)
A cloud.
E.
न negative, भ्राज to shine, affix क्विप्.

m. (-कः)
Ruptured or protruded navel.
E.
नाभि a navel, and कण्टक a thorn.

m. (-कः)
A prominent or ruptured navel.
E.
नाभि, and गुडक a ball or lump.

m. (-कः)
A prominent or ruptured navel.
E.
नाभि, and गोलक a lump or ball.

n. (-नं)
Division of the umbilical cord.
E.
नाभि, and छेदन cutting.

m. (-जः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
नाभि navel, and ज born; BRAHMĀ appearing from the lotus which sprung from the navel of VIṢṆU.

m. (-न्मा)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
नाभि the navel, and जन्मन birth: see the last.

f. (-डी)
The umbilical cord.
E.
नाभि, and नाडी a vessel.

f. (-ला)
The umbilical cord.
E.
नाभि the navel, and नाला a string, a vessel.

m. (-भूः)
BRAHMĀ.
E.
नाभि, and भू born: see नाभिज.

n. (-नं)
1 Division of the umbilical cord.
2 Umbilical hernia.
3 Corpulency.
E.
नाभि, and वर्द्धन increasing.

n. (-लं)
1 The groin of a woman.
2 A prominent or ruptured navel.
3

Pain.
4

The hollow of the navel.
E.
नाभि the navel, लच् aff.

m. (-र्त्तः)
The hollow or pit of the navel.
E.
नाभि a navel, आवर्त्त a round.
